reviews.comment: She has clear expectations and is always willing to help. There is an in class assignment pretty much every class, and attendance is mandatory with minimal allowed absences. That being said the class is very interesting and is only strenuous is you get behind on the readings.

ENGL 210 is a work heavy class, but taking it online makes the work load seem greater. There will very rarely be a M, W, or F that you won't have some kind of assignment due, and I sometimes found myself needing to do a little bit of work everyday to handle it all. Also be aware that a big portion of this class is centered around a group project.

She's understanding, caring and gives good feedback. It's not an entirely "easy A" class, but as long as you do all the assignments you should do well. You will have to read the textbook sometimes because she prefers specific formats on papers. Overall, good prof
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The online course had 2-3 assignments per week, but it was very manageable. Ungyung was very responsive to any questions or concerns I had. There's a lot of writing (duh), but as long as you follow the assignments and do all the discussions, you'll get an A.
